style_guide.art_style: Polished Korean romance webtoon style with expressive romantic comedy acting, attractive characters, soft cinematic framing, clean modern manhwa aesthetics
style_guide.render_style: Finished vertical webtoon panel, clean digital painting, soft shading, subtle texture, high detail faces, readable expressions
style_guide.line_style: Clean line art, elegant thin-to-medium outlines, expressive facial lines, subtle comedic exaggeration when needed
style_guide.color_palette: COVID-era urban cafe palette, soft beige, muted pink, clean white, gentle blue-gray shadows, warm skin tones
style_guide.lighting_style: Soft natural daylight for clinic and cafe, cozy indoor lighting for rooms, subtle dramatic shadow for Seowoo tension scenes
style_guide.global_negative_prompt: low quality, blurry, extra fingers, distorted face, inconsistent character design, unreadable text, messy speech bubbles, western comic style, overly realistic photo, horror, gore

episode.title: 밀접접촉자입니다 - 1
episode.style: COVID testing clinic anxiety, romantic comedy first comfort, masked distance tension

character_bible.name: 윤아진
character_bible.role: female lead, COVID-rule obsessed student preparing to study abroad
character_bible.visual_core: fresh rabbit-like beauty, bright clear eyes, soft cheeks, neat black or dark brown hair, youthful and intelligent aura, expressive blush
character_bible.wardrobe: neat casual campus clothes, KF94 mask, small crossbody bag, always carrying sanitizer, wipes, spare masks, study-abroad document folder
character_bible.expression_notes: easily flustered, anxious when COVID or study abroad is mentioned, tries to look rational, blushes when Jihwak flirts
character_bible.personality_notes: smart, rule-abiding, sincere, overthinks romance as symptoms, clumsy only with emotions

character_bible.name: 강지확
character_bible.role: male lead, instinctively charming and direct
character_bible.visual_core: Arabian puppy-like handsome face, thick eyebrows, deep eyes, sharp facial structure, slightly exotic first impression, warm playful eyes when smiling
character_bible.wardrobe: clean casual clothes, hoodie or knit, black or white mask, simple bag, relaxed but stylish campus look
character_bible.expression_notes: playful eyes, relaxed smile, becomes quietly sincere when A-jin is anxious, flirts naturally without overacting
character_bible.personality_notes: unaware star quality, capable, warm, direct once he cares, jokes to ease tension

character_bible.name: 백서우
character_bible.role: second male lead, soft controlling antagonist
character_bible.visual_core: tofu-fox type, pale clean face, gentle eyes, neat hair, elegant and controlled expression, beautiful but cold under the surface
character_bible.wardrobe: neat shirt or cardigan, perfectly worn mask, clean campus style, carries carefully prepared care kits
character_bible.expression_notes: soft smile with cold eyes, tiny cracks when jealous, calm voice, suppressed possessiveness
character_bible.personality_notes: perfectly helpful on the outside, controlling kindness, jealous of Jihwak, wants to be chosen by A-jin

character_bible.name: 민서
character_bible.visual_core: lively Korean college girl, playful eyes, casual ponytail or bob, friendly expressive face
character_bible.wardrobe: casual cafe staff outfit or comfy room-call look, mask when outside
character_bible.expression_notes: teasing smile, exaggerated reactions, laughs easily
character_bible.personality_notes: quick-witted, sees romantic signs before A-jin does, comic relief

scenes.scene_summary: 아진과 지확이 확진자 동선 알림을 받고 밀접접촉자로 엮이기 시작한다.
scenes.location: night street outside the cafe / phone screen space
scenes.visual_continuity: Dark quiet COVID-era street, phone notification glow, both wearing masks, anxious atmosphere with comedic text-message rhythm.

cuts.visual_prompt: Black vertical panel with a large Korean public health notification displayed like a phone alert, dramatic minimal composition, COVID-era warning mood
cuts.composition: Phone notification fills most of the vertical panel, black empty space around it for tension
narration: [안내] 귀하는 확진자와 동선이 겹친 것으로 확인되었습니다. 가까운 선별진료소에서 검사를 받으시기 바랍니다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Yoon A-jin standing outside the cafe at night, wearing a KF94 mask, holding phone with trembling hands, study-abroad document folder visible in her bag
cuts.composition: A-jin centered, phone glow reflected in her eyes, quiet street behind her

cuts.visual_prompt: Close-up of A-jin's phone receiving a message from Kang Jihwak, clean webtoon phone UI without overly detailed small text
cuts.composition: Phone screen angled in her hand, message bubble emphasized

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin frozen, finger hovering above reply keyboard, conflicted and embarrassed even during a crisis
cuts.composition: Her flushed eyes above mask, phone in foreground

cuts.visual_prompt: Phone screen with Jihwak's playful message, A-jin's face reflected faintly on the glass
cuts.composition: Message bubble large, A-jin's eyes reflected

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin suddenly blushing hard, flipping her phone face down in panic, night street background
cuts.composition: Comedic motion lines as phone is flipped, A-jin leaning forward

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 이 상황에서 단어가 왜 이렇게 이상하게 들리냐고…

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin peeking at the phone again despite herself, tiny smile forming under her mask
cuts.composition: Phone lower foreground, her softened eyes above mask
narration: 그런데 이상하게, 강지확은 알림 하나로 내 일상에 들어왔다.

scenes.scene_summary: 아진은 완전무장으로 선별진료소에 가고, 줄 뒤에서 지확과 재회한다.
scenes.visual_continuity: Long outdoor testing queue, white tents, distancing marks, all people masked. A-jin is heavily prepared with sanitizer, gloves, spare masks.

cuts.visual_prompt: Wide vertical shot of a COVID testing clinic in the morning, long socially distanced queue, white tents, masked people, cold clean light
cuts.composition: A-jin small in the line, fully prepared, vertical depth showing the queue
narration: 다음 날 아침. 선별진료소 앞은 길게 줄이 늘어서 있었다.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin in full protective preparation: KF94 mask, sanitizer, disposable gloves, antibacterial wipes, spare mask pouch; Minseo appears on video call screen teasing her
cuts.composition: A-jin in line, phone screen showing Minseo in corner

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin gripping study abroad folder while speaking through video call, worried eyes above mask
cuts.composition: Folder labeled D-13 or study abroad documents visible, Minseo on phone screen

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 출국 전 검사에서 양성 나오면 일정 다 꼬여. 비자, 항공권, 기숙사까지…

cuts.visual_prompt: Kang Jihwak appears behind A-jin in the testing queue, mask on, eyes smiling mischievously
cuts.composition: A-jin foreground startled, Jihwak behind at safe distance

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin stepping back dramatically and holding out her palm, Jihwak calmly pointing at the distance marks
cuts.composition: Wide empty space between them emphasized with distance markers

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak's eyes soften as he asks about her study abroad worries, A-jin caught off guard
cuts.composition: A-jin side profile, Jihwak background, distance preserved

cuts.visual_prompt: Soft close-up of Jihwak's masked face, warm eyes, morning light, clinic tents blurred
cuts.composition: Jihwak centered, gentle expression

dialogue.speaker: 강지확
dialogue.text: 윤아진 씨는 그렇게 쉽게 무너질 사람처럼 안 보여서.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin looking at Jihwak, surprised that his words comfort her, clinic noise fading visually
cuts.composition: Background washed out, focus on her eyes above mask
narration: 처음 만난 사람의 말인데, 왜 잠깐 믿고 싶어졌을까.

scenes.scene_summary: 검사 장면에서 로코 티키타카가 이어지고, 이후 각자 집에서 메시지를 주고받는다.
scenes.visual_continuity: Clinic booth sterile white, then A-jin's room with study abroad documents, laptop checklist, anxious but cozy atmosphere.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin sitting at the COVID testing booth, eyes wide with fear as medical worker holds swab, sterile white tent
cuts.composition: Swab in foreground, A-jin leaning back slightly

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak teasing from behind the line, A-jin instantly fired up before the swab test
cuts.composition: Jihwak in background, A-jin foreground turning sharply

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin after the swab test with watery eyes, insisting she did not cry, comedic sparkle tears
cuts.composition: Her eyes watery, brows determined

cuts.visual_prompt: Jihwak walking toward his test booth, looking back with playful eyes; A-jin freezes at his flirty line
cuts.composition: Jihwak moving right, A-jin in background frozen

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin back in her room, sitting at desk with laptop checklist for study abroad, hands clasped in prayer
cuts.composition: Checklist visible on laptop, masks and sanitizer neatly arranged

cuts.visual_prompt: Phone message from Jihwak appears while A-jin sits in her room, soft comedic tone
cuts.composition: Phone in foreground, A-jin's tired face behind
narration: 윤아진: 네. 검사 때문에 코만 죽었습니다.

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin throws phone onto bed after Jihwak calls her cute, then immediately reaches for it again
cuts.composition: Phone bouncing on bed, A-jin blushing and frustrated

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin hesitates, types 'Are you okay?' and sends it, then regrets being too kind
cuts.composition: Her finger pressing send, her eyes panicked

cuts.visual_prompt: A-jin burying face into pillow as Jihwak's reply appears on phone beside her
cuts.composition: Phone screen glowing next to pillow, A-jin curled up

dialogue.speaker: 윤아진
dialogue.text: 이 사람 진짜 위험해. 방역 대상 맞아.

narration: 강지확: 저도 괜찮아요. 근데 윤아진 씨가 걱정해주니까 좀 아픈 척하고 싶네요.
